mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the aerating return reservoir was most worthwhile: the falling return stream explains how the solution mixes with air before recirculation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to attach the prepared reservoir directly was frustrating because its description said it fit beneath the beds, but the missing drain runs were not yet apparent.

surprise.text: Inspecting the lined beds automatically installed the drain runs and completed the first goal; the hose was needed there as well as for the reservoir.

arbitrary.text: The required order felt unclear when the reservoir could not connect directly despite being described as fitting beneath the frames. The later drainage explanation gave it a physical purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the different root zones are prepared and supplied, since the drainage and aeration details made the construction informative.
